integrity: All exact theorems are proved analytically; the executable script provides only sample and polynomial checks. No independent review or validation was performed.
scientific_limitations: Constant-coefficient, zero-initial-condition, two-layer linear model; prescribed radiative-forcing pulse only; no carbon cycle, heterogeneous efficacy, or nonlinear ocean response. Further obscure or inaccessible analytical-corollary literature can affect originality.
title: A sharp four-parameter delay law for deep-ocean warming after a finite forcing pulse
